entries.name: asyncio.gather
entries.description: Schedules awaitables concurrently and returns results in input order.
entries.definition: Schedules awaitables concurrently and returns results in input order.
entries.template:
import asyncio

async def {worker}({argument}):
    await asyncio.sleep(0)
    return {expression}

async def main():
    results = await asyncio.gather(*({worker}(value) for value in {values}))
    print(results)

asyncio.run(main())

asyncio.run(main())

entries.name: asyncio.TaskGroup
entries.description: Runs a group of tasks and waits for all of them when leaving the context.
entries.definition: Runs a group of tasks and waits for all of them when leaving the context.
entries.template:
import asyncio

async def {worker}({argument}):
    await asyncio.sleep(0)
    return {expression}

async def main():
    async with asyncio.TaskGroup() as group:
        task = group.create_task({worker}({value}))
    print(task.result())

asyncio.run(main())
